p: Judah: He means Judah and Benjamin.
Michaiah the daughter of: Or Maacah, 1Ki 15:2.
Uriel of Gibeah: Called also Absalom, for Absalom was her grandfather, 1Ki 15:2.
Zemaraim: Which was one of the peaks of mount Ephraim.
David for ever: Therefore whoever usurps it or takes it from that stock transgresses the ordinance of the Lord. Thus like a hypocrite he alleges the word of God for his advantage.
vain men: This word in the Chaldee tongue is Racha, which our saviour uses, Mt 5:22.
young and tenderhearted: Meaning, in heart and courage.

young bullock and seven rams: He shows the nature of idolaters who take no trial of the calling, life and doctrine of their ministers, but think the most vile and greatest beasts sufficient to serve their turn.
morning and every evening burnt sacrifices: As it was appointed in the law, Ex 29:39.
with us for our captain: Because their cause was good and approved by the Lord, they did not doubt the success and victory.
to come about behind them: Contemning the good counsel which came from the Spirit of God, he thought to have overcome by deceit.
because they relied upon the LORD: He shows that the stay of all kingdoms and assurance of victories depends on our trust and confidence in the Lord.
